tech.stonecutting.name: Stonecutting
tech.stonecutting.desc: Breaking hillside rock into blocks opens the quarry and the cobbled road.
tech.pathfinding.name: Pathfinding
tech.pathfinding.desc: Beaten paths lead scouts out to the unknown parts of the island.
tech.pottery.name: Pottery
tech.pottery.desc: Riverbank clay, shaped and fired, becomes pots that keep for years.
tech.orcharding.name: Orcharding
tech.orcharding.desc: Grafted trees in tended rows bear apples for eating and pressing.
tech.crop_rotation.name: Crop Rotation
tech.crop_rotation.desc: Resting each field in turn keeps the soil kind, so fewer hands grow the same grain.
tech.bridge_building.name: Bridge-building
tech.bridge_building.desc: Timber spans carry roads across narrow rivers.
tech.masonry.name: Masonry
tech.masonry.desc: Dressed stone raises storehouses, shrines and plazas that outlast their builders.
tech.letters.name: Letters
tech.letters.desc: Marks pressed in clay keep tallies and names, and the scribes keep them.
tech.town_charter.name: Town Charter
tech.town_charter.desc: A sealed charter names the town and its moot: the gateway to the Township era.
civic.oral_tradition.name: Oral Tradition
civic.oral_tradition.desc: Stories told and retold bind the village to its past.
civic.sea_lore.name: Sea Lore
civic.sea_lore.desc: Reading tides and gull-flight fills the weirs as the nets once did.
civic.kinship.name: Kinship
civic.kinship.desc: Every house knows its neighbours, and every raising finds hands.
civic.harvest_rites.name: Harvest Rites
civic.harvest_rites.desc: Bread shared at the fair binds the year together.
civic.craft_lore.name: Craft Lore
civic.craft_lore.desc: Loom and kiln keep their own slow knowledge, handed down by watching.
civic.remembrance.name: Remembrance
civic.remembrance.desc: The old stones are raised again, so the dead have an address.
civic.village_moot.name: Village Moot
civic.village_moot.desc: Every hearth sends a voice: the gateway to the Township era.
tradition.common_hearth.name: Common Hearth
tradition.common_hearth.desc: No house eats alone; every hearth holds one more.
tradition.fireside_tales.name: Fireside Tales
tradition.fireside_tales.desc: Long evenings of stories make the young curious.
tradition.many_hands.name: Many Hands
tradition.many_hands.desc: Raisings and launchings go up fast when everyone comes.
tradition.harvest_festival.name: Harvest Festival
tradition.harvest_festival.desc: Autumn work sings, and the fields give a little more.
tradition.tide_blessing.name: Tide Blessing
tradition.tide_blessing.desc: A gift to the sea before launching brings the boats home full.
tradition.village_crafts.name: Village Crafts
tradition.village_crafts.desc: Loom and kiln run truer, and fewer hands tend them.
tradition.old_ways.name: Old Ways
tradition.old_ways.desc: The old songs at the shrines still draw a crowd.
tradition.common_voice.name: Common Voice
tradition.common_voice.desc: Grievances are heard before they harden, and fewer houses drift away.
festival.harvest_fair.name: Harvest Fair
festival.harvest_fair.desc: Bread and fish on long tables, music, and new neighbours arriving.
building.scribes_hall.name: Scribe's Hall
building.scribes_hall.desc: Keepers of tallies and letters, where the island's knowledge is written down.
building.storytellers_circle.name: Storyteller's Circle
building.storytellers_circle.desc: A ring of benches where epics are told and retold.
building.festival_ground.name: Festival Ground
building.festival_ground.desc: An open green with bunting poles, kept ready for fairs.
building.standing_stones.name: Standing Stones
building.standing_stones.desc: Three great stones raised in stages, the island's first monument.
monument.standing_stones.name: Standing Stones
monument.standing_stones.desc: Three great stones raised in stages, the island's first monument.
era.township.name: Township
era.township.desc: A chartered town with a moot, ready for crafts and coin.
happening.travelling_scholar.name: A Travelling Scholar
happening.travelling_scholar.desc: A scholar from across the water asks for a bed and offers a satchel of notes.
happening.bountiful_catch.name: A Bountiful Catch
happening.bountiful_catch.desc: The boats come in low in the water, heavy with fish.
happening.bountiful_catch.option.0.label: Smoke the surplus
happening.bountiful_catch.option.1.label: Share it with neighbours
happening.fair_request.name: The Fair Is Asked For
happening.fair_request.desc: The fishers ask for a Harvest Fair, and offer to help bear the cost.
happening.fair_request.option.0.label: Promise them the fair
happening.fair_request.option.1.label: Not this season
happening.wreck_salvage.name: A Wreck in the Shoals
happening.wreck_salvage.desc: A wreck found by the scouts still holds sound timbers.
happening.wreck_salvage.option.0.label: Salvage the timbers
happening.wreck_salvage.option.1.label: Leave it to the gulls
happening.lost_lamb.name: A Lost Lamb
happening.lost_lamb.desc: A lamb has wandered from the flock into the gorse.
happening.lost_lamb.option.0.label: Send the children to find it
happening.lost_lamb.option.1.label: Let it wander home
happening.storytellers_visit.name: Wandering Storytellers
happening.storytellers_visit.desc: Storytellers pass through and offer an evening of tales.
happening.fair_weather.name: Fair Weather
happening.fair_weather.desc: A kind summer week ripens the fields early.
happening.fair_weather.option.0.label: Make hay while it lasts
happening.fair_weather.option.1.label: Rest in the shade
happening.stone_find.name: A Stone Find
happening.stone_find.desc: A farmer turns up fine building stone at the field's edge.
happening.stone_find.option.0.label: Cut it for walls
happening.stone_find.option.1.label: Leave it where it lies
happening.mended_nets.name: Mended Nets
happening.mended_nets.desc: The fishers have mended every net and eye the deep run.
happening.mended_nets.option.0.label: Fish the deep run
happening.mended_nets.option.1.label: Keep to the shallows
happening.hearth_tales.name: Hearth Tales
happening.hearth_tales.desc: The old stories are especially good this winter; someone should write them down.
happening.hearth_tales.option.0.label: Write them down
happening.hearth_tales.option.1.label: Just listen
